name: sidecove
description: Spaces, pinned tabs and favourites in Chrome's side panel, for people moving from Arc. Optional auto-archive. Free, no tracking.

scripts.build:zip: npm run build && npm run zip
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' jest --config jest.config.js
scripts.test:spaces: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' jest tests/e2e/spaces.test.js
scripts.test:tabs: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' jest tests/e2e/tabs.test.js
scripts.test:bookmarks: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' jest tests/e2e/bookmarks.test.js
scripts.test:drag: npm run build && NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' jest tests/e2e/drag-drop.test.js

author: Matthew Moorcroft
